cohort: 617 participants (mean age: 28.2 years, 78.6% Hispanic, 11.8% non-Hispanic Black) from the MADRES pregnancy cohort in Los Angeles, California.
finding: Exposure to PM2.5, PM10, and NO2 in a periconceptional window (5 weeks before to 5 weeks after conception) was associated with an increased risk of GDM.
